silhouette.reason: Bald head, long pointed ears and hooked nose read as a goblin from every view.
fixes: notch the ear rims and push the brow ridge out

proportions.reason: Large ears, long nose and slim neck read; the eyes are still small for a goblin.

materials.reason: Skin now has sheen and the eyes are glossy, but the sheen is uniform over head and shoulders, so it reads as wet latex.
fixes: vary roughness: rougher on the scalp and shoulders, sheen only on nose, brow and lips

detail.reason: Teeth and ears present, but the face is smooth: no wrinkles, pores or warts.
fixes: LOD0 wrinkle/wart displacement on forehead, nose and cheeks

wear.reason: Brown blotches and a pale scar on the cheek; reads as mottled skin rather than history.
fixes: a torn ear notch and two clearer scars

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the ears and the nose; the face is faceted into flat patches.
fixes: authored LOD2 topology with smoothed colour
